deploymentCeiling: Practice/demo exclusively. Live capital deployment BLOCKED (requires new SPEC + Level-2 fidelity + Tri-Proof + 4-way quorum).
disconnectThaw: MANUAL_RESET_ONLY. No auto-restart. New provenance entry required to resume after freeze.
evidenceStatus: EXPLORATORY_UNVALIDATED. All outputs quarantined. No acceptance power, no promotion, no economic claim. MUST NOT feed H011 IS/OOS without explicit declaration + contamination audit at F2. MUST NOT invoke H010 (or any frozen model) logic.
otcPolicy: REJECT. Any observation with market != 'regular' is ignored and logged. Regular and OTC are separate mathematical universes and MUST NEVER be merged.
payoutRule: OBSERVED_ONLY. Dispatch is BLOCKED until the payout observer holds a venue snapshot for the asset+market. Failsafe bridge defaults MUST NEVER be used as economic assumptions. Each filled trade records the applied payoutRate + snapshot source. Intraday payout changes pause dispatch only if a stricter config version says so; v1.0.0 records and continues.
signalPolicy: Default provider returns NO_SIGNAL (zero trading out of the box). Enabling directional dispatch requires a NEW fence-config version + new hash. Execution layer contains NO signal generation and NO sizing logic (Chinese Wall).
sizing: Fixed stake 1.0 per trade. Martingale, Kelly, progression, or signal-supplied stake are PROHIBITED. Signal stake fields are ignored and logged as tamper attempts.
